payload.claim: The spec's own "Notes for the agent" state that no criterion carries a mutant yet and that `witness` is expected to report `skip` on every criterion, with the mutant ref's creation left to "the operator's call." This means the mutation-testing confirmation that each named witness actually fails a plausible wrong build will not run for any of this spec's four criteria at build time. A person should decide this is acceptable before the cell is paid for, even though the spec discloses it honestly.
